title: Failure probability bound for sequential programs
statement: Let $T$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $P$ be a learning program with output in $\alpha$, and let $Q$ assign a learning program with output in $\beta$ to each element of $\alpha$. Suppose $\delta_1,\delta_2\geq 0$, the probability that the output of $P$ satisfies a predicate $A$ is at most $\delta_1$, and for every $a\in\alpha$ not satisfying $A$, the probability that the output of $Q(a)$ satisfies a predicate $B$ is at most $\delta_2$. Then the probability that the output of the program obtained by binding $P$ to $Q$ satisfies $B$ is at most $\delta_1+\delta_2$.
